The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640701a0ea8d8026), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 1-2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Let A/Q be an abelian variety of dimension d with good reduction A0/F at w. Let 0 ≤ r ≤ d, and let γ ∈ H2r (A(C), Q(r)) be a rational Hodge class. For every list of Cartier divisors D1, . . . , Dd−r on A0, there is a number q ∈ Q such that Trℓ γ0,ℓc1,ℓ(D1) · · · c1,ℓ(Dd−r)  = q in Qℓ (ℓ ̸= p), Trp γ0,pc1,cris(D1) · · · c1,cris(Dd−r)  = q in Cw. Here γ0,ℓ is the smooth proper specialization of the ℓ-adic realization, and γ0,p is the de Rham–crystalline specialization in H2r cris(A0/W(F))[1/p](r) ⊗K0 Cw. 1 The traces use the top Tate twist and send the class of a zero-cycle to its degree. If r = d, the divisor product is 1.
